title: Kill chain progress rate tracking: map findings and phase completions to MITRE ATT&CK stages and show progress gauge
goal: AutoPenBench measures Progress Rate (PR) — how far an agent progressed through the kill chain even if it didn't fully succeed. AegisPT has MITRE ATT&CK data in threat intelligence but NO kill chain progress tracking per engagement. MITRE ATT&CK records are already imported (threat_intel.py). Implement kill chain progress tracking: (1) Map each finding type to a MITRE ATT&CK tactic: nmap scan finding → Reconnaissance (TA0043), service vulnerability → Initial Access (TA0001), credential finding → Credential Access (TA0006), SUID escalation → Privilege Escalation (TA0004), lateral movement finding → Lateral Movement (TA0008), etc. This mapping is static and stored in a FINDING_ATT&CK_MAP in ai_agent.py or a new constants file. (2) Per engagement, compute a Kill Chain Progress gauge: what percentage of the ATT&CK kill chain has been reached. Example: 'Reached: Reconnaissance ✓ → Initial Access ✓ → Execution ✓ → Privilege Escalation ○ → Persistence ○ → Lateral Movement ○'. (3) Show this in Mission Control as a horizontal kill chain strip. Completed stages are green, current stage is amber, future stages are grey. (4) In the engagement dossier (Explorer), show full MITRE ATT&CK matrix view with confirmed vs tested vs untested techniques. This matches AutoPenBench's PR metric and gives operators an enterprise-grade view of assessment completeness.
scope: AutoPenBench: Progress Rate (PR) measures kill chain advancement. AegisPT has custom phase tiers but no standardized kill chain progress. MITRE ATT&CK data already imported in threat_intel.py but not connected to findings.
generation_reason: AutoPenBench PR metric + MITRE ATT&CK mapping is the enterprise-standard way to communicate assessment depth. AegisPT has the data but not the connection.
